title: still present since round 4: demo exit from a dirty edit page clears demo state BEFORE the unsaved-changes guard fires
location: client/src/client.gleam:492-497 (clear then handle_browser_change); client/src/client.gleam:5404-5412 (guard inside handle_browser_change)
detail: Public-route demo exit still clears demo state first; the guard then runs on a post-clear model — choosing "stay" strands a non-demo VacancyEdit with restored/NotAsked auth. Same order as r4.
recommended_fix: Run the unsaved-changes guard before clear_demo_state on demo exits (or skip clearing until the guard resolves to leave).

title: still present since round 4: latent policy re-acceptance modal could surface in demo and fire a real accept_policy POST (UserAcceptedPolicy is EXEMPT_ARMS, not intercepted)
evidence:
client.gleam:1375-1386: '    UserAcceptedPolicy ->
      case model.policy_reaccept_loading {
        True -> #(model, effect.none())
        False -> #(
          Model(..model, policy_reaccept_loading: True),
          auth_api.accept_policy(
            version: model.server_policy_version,
            csrf_token: model.csrf_token,'. lint EXEMPT_ARMS contains '"UserAcceptedPolicy",'. demo_fixtures.gleam:26: '"accepted_policy_version\":\"2026-05-23\"}"' with comment 'matches the current server policy version (shared/policy_highlights) so the re-acceptance modal never fires inside the demo'; policy_highlights.gleam:18: 'pub const version: String = "2026-05-23"'. demo_update.gleam has no UserAcceptedPolicy interception; enter_demo does not reset server_policy_version.
detail: Safety rests on the fixture string tracking the server version: after any future policy bump, an authed landlord entering demo re-arms the modal and UserAcceptedPolicy fires a real POST with the demo csrf.

title: still present since round 4: demo comparison ids and sweep-nudge dismissals write to real web storage
detail: Demo-mode dispatches persist fixture ids (v-maples etc.) into real web storage; after exit/signup the real app hydrates them into live comparison/sweep-nudge state.
recommended_fix: Branch these persistence calls on !model.demo_mode (in-memory only), mirroring the // demo: branches elsewhere.

title: W11's optimistic unread_count fix landed but its model-level pin stays vacuous — demo_model() starts at unread_count 0
detail: The behavior fix is real and bites in the browser, but reverting `unread_count: 0` in the demo arm stays green — the r4 pin-vacuity half of W11 was not addressed.
recommended_fix: Set unread_count: 2 on the pin's model before dispatching UserClickedMarkAllRead so the 0 assert distinguishes the optimistic update.
